title: Calendar
summary: Your calendar's events in a list you, your widgets and your agents can read: from Connect Google, every 15 minutes with invitations and your answers, or every hour from its secret ICS link in Google Calendar or Outlook. Nothing is written back to the calendar.
changes: Events no longer opens on a line counting what is on today and coming up, since the lists under it show them. Nothing it reads or writes changed.
author: BrainDog

address.label: Key holding the calendar link
address.note: Only if you do not connect Google. Copy your calendar's secret ICS link (Google Calendar: Settings, your calendar, Secret address in iCal format; Outlook: Settings, Shared calendars, Publish a calendar, ICS) and add it to your keys as Calendar link.
